name: Eirik
title: Smith
examine: Points, traps, nails, and the truth: he is a good smith and not a great one, and he will tell you so before you ask. Silverfall work makes him whistle.
lines: I mend. I point. I do not master. Silverfall masters.
A trap is a promise you make the fold.
Bring me Balla's work to look at and the mending is half price.
